versions.content: An RTE_E_DET_SEG_FAULT (0x06) shall be reported by the RTE when the parameters of an RTE API call contain a direct or indirect reference to memory that is not accessible from the callers partition as defined in [SWS_Rte_02752] and [SWS_Rte_02753].

An RTE_E_DET_SEG_FAULT (0x06) shall be reported by the RTE when the parameters of an RTE API call contain a direct or indirect reference to memory that is not accessible from the callers partition as defined in [SWS_Rte_02752] and [SWS_Rte_02753].
